To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
We present a novel binary network design which, for the same computational cost, achieves a $\sim6 \%$ higher classification accuracy than prior state-of-the-art methods on ImageNet.

1) Expert Binary Networks are the first binary networks to learn to select one data specific binary filter at a test time, conditioned on the input features, which allows for an increase in model capacity; 2) Efficient Width Expansion allows to address the information bottleneck in binary neural networks, by increasing the number of filters, without increasing the number of binary operations; 3) Binary Network Growth is the first principled binary network design mechanism that unveils binary network topologies of favourable properties.

(a) We introduce a principled binary convolution that allows for the selection of one data-specific expert filter at a time, (b) We propose to address the information bottleneck in binary neural networks by introducing a width expansion mechanism, (c) We introduce a binary network growth mechanism, and (d) Our method achieves state-of-the-art performance, reaching a groundbreaking $\mathbf{71.1\%}$ on the ImageNet classification task
